title: Edge Partner Listing Integration Brief (WIP)
content:
TL;DR:
This doc is a working brief for integrating an "edge" ISV partner into public cloud marketplaces (AWS/GCP/Azure). Focus: copy variants, SKU/pricing constraints, telemetry/metrics gating, and a minimally acceptable acceptance checklist for marketplace QA.

Background and goal:
- Partner: EdgeComputeCo (hypothetical) ships an on-prem/edge routing appliance that uses Redwood Dedicated for low-latency model inference. They want a marketplace listing that bundles Redwood Dedicated reserved capacity with their connector and a managed onboarding service.
- Goal: produce a marketplace-ready listing and a partner integration checklist that engineering, security, and GTM can run against in a 3-week sprint.

Primary audience:
- Internal: marketplace program manager, partner manager, platform engineering, security review, billing ops.
- External: ISV PM, channel partner manager, enterprise procurement.

Copy brief (short + long variants)
- Short (<= 150 chars for listing title/summary):
  "Low-latency inference for edge apps — Redwood Dedicated + EdgeComputeCo connector. Reserved capacity, simplified billing, enterprise support."
- Long (300–500 char description for marketplace detail page):
  "Combine Redwood Inference's Dedicated GPU reservations with EdgeComputeCo's secure connector to run high-throughput LLM inference close to users. This bundle provides predictable latency SLA, automated model version pinning, and a managed onboarding package for regulated environments. Ideal for retail, telecom, and industrial IoT use cases where latency and data locality matter."
- Feature bullets (for quick scan):
  - Predictable latency with reserved GPU pools and autoscaling
  - Private connector for VPC and air-gapped deployments
  - Model version pinning + automated rollouts
  - Per-token cost visibility and token-level observability
  - Enterprise onboarding and optional on-prem deployment package

SKU & pricing mapping (constraints and recommendations)
- Make the listing a bundle SKU with three tiers: Starter, Scale, Enterprise. Each maps to a Redwood Dedicated commit level (vCPU/GPU equivalent) and partner onboarding hours.
- Pricing considerations: marketplaces often restrict meter granularity. Choose a single monthly subscription SKU with optional add-on metered items (support hours, on-prem installer). Avoid per-token metering as primary SKU — use it as usage detail in billing.
- Labeling: SKU ids should follow partner naming: RDW-EDGE-START, RDW-EDGE-SCALE, RDW-EDGE-ENT. Document proposed MSRP and marketplace-visible benefits per tier.

Technical integration checklist (minimum viable for listing acceptance)
- Technical artifacts to attach to listing: integration guide PDF, architecture diagram (SVG/PNG), minimal deploy script, and a sanitized demo video (<= 3 min).
- API hooks: partner must map to Redwood Dedicated endpoints via documented auth (JWT with key rotation). Provide example curl and SDK snippet.
- Runtime compatibility: declare supported model families, quantization profiles. Note any hardware constraints (A10G, H100 recommended).
- Network: list ports, VPC connector steps, and cross-account IAM roles required.

Security & compliance gating
- Required docs: SOC2 type II attestation OR equivalent partner attestation, data processing addendum, and privacy policy link.
- Secrets management: require usage of KMS-backed secrets; marketplace listing must not include plaintext keys.
- Static analysis: provide SBOM for connector and a summary of third-party libs (esp. native runtime components).

Telemetry and observability requirements
- Essential metrics to surface in marketplace tile/description: 99th-pct latency (ms), average tokens/sec, error rate, and per-tenant cost delta.
- Minimum telemetry contract: partner must emit (or Redwood must proxy) the following events: deployment.created, claim.succeeded, inference.request.latency (p50/p95/p99), inference.request.error. Provide example OpenTelemetry schema snippets in the integration guide.
- Billing reconciliation: link telemetry -> usage reports for marketplace billing reconciliation. Define cadence (daily CSV export or API).

Marketplace QA acceptance criteria
- Content: Short/long copy present, logo in correct format, one-line benefit bullets, 2–3 screenshots, and a short demo video.
- Technical: Integration guide uploaded, example deployment runs successfully in partner sandbox, telemetry endpoints reachable and emitting expected events.
- Security: DPA uploaded, KMS integration validated, SBOM attached.
- Legal/Compliance: Entitlement language matches Redwood and partner legal approved copy (attach signed addendum).

Launch & rollout plan (phased)
- Phase 0 (preflight): Obtain partner legal signoff, decide SKU mapping, collect assets. (Week 0–1)
- Phase 1 (sandbox): Upload draft listing to marketplace staging, run integration smoke tests, verify telemetry. (Week 2)
- Phase 2 (soft launch): Publish listing to selected geos (US/EU), onboard 2 pilot customers, monitor metrics closely. (Week 3–5)
- Phase 3 (general availability): Full public listing, press/social playbook, docs page live, partner co-marketing assets distributed. (Week 6)

Support playbook snippets (for partner ops and CS)
- Quick reply example to inbound leads: "Thanks — we'll coordinate a 30-min tech call to scope latency targets and region support. Please share your VPC CIDR and expected QPS."
- Entitlement escalation: map support tiers to SLA windows and partner onboarding hours. Provide contact matrix (email, Slack channel).

Open questions (to resolve before staging)
- Do we allow per-token metering as a complementary metered SKU in the marketplace, or restrict to subscription-only visible SKU?
- What is the minimum telemetry retention window required by marketplace billing reconciliation (30d vs 90d)?
- Who owns the demo sandbox environment for final QA (Partner vs Redwood)?

Next steps / Action items
- [Arielle] Finalize copy variants and submit to partner for signoff (due 2026-03-17).
- [Daniel] Prepare integration guide draft and sample SDK snippets (due 2026-03-20).
- [Maya] Collect security artifacts and confirm SBOM formatting (due 2026-03-18).
- [Omar] Provision staging listing and run telemetry smoke tests (target 2026-03-24).

Notes to self / rough ideas (informal):
- Consider an "edge accelerator" badge in Marketplace UX for listings that include Dedicated + private connector. Could boost conversions.
- Draft a short partnership FAQ addressing customer questions about data residency and fallback behavior to hosted API.

Attachments to assemble for final package:
- Draft listing copy (short + long), 3 screenshots (admin console + connector UI), 1 demo video (2–3 min), integration guide (PDF), architecture diagram, DPA, SBOM, sample billing CSV mapping.

Historical references / links:
- See previous marketplace bundles for reference: CONFLUENCE-1122 (dedicated-bundle-playbook)
- Slack thread: #marketplace-edge-integration-2026 for realtime notes and vendor syncs.

End of brief.

(Working doc — expect edits. Use this as the single source of truth while we iterate copy and acceptance criteria.)
